item.title: How to Use Angular Lifecycle Hooks
item.description: Angular lifecycle hooks provide precise control over component behavior at different stages of the component lifecycle. As the creator of CoreUI, I use lifecycle hooks extensively to manage component initialization, data fetching, cleanup, and performance optimization. These hooks allow you to tap into key moments in a component’s life cycle.

item.title: How to Use ngOnInit in Angular
item.description: As the creator of CoreUI, I’ll show you how to properly use the ngOnInit lifecycle hook for component initialization and data setup.
